name: Entropy-weighted gradient k-means++
tagline: BADGE k-means++ in gradient-embedding space, with the selection probability multiplied by an entropy weight whose floor adapts to the number of classes.

key_hyperparams.name: weight_floor
key_hyperparams.role: uncertainty/diversity trade-off, adapts with class count C

init_recovers: BADGE when entropy weights become uniform (e.g. high floor)
diff_from_baseline: Modifies BADGE k-means++ by multiplying both the initial argmax score and the squared-distance sampling weights by an entropy weight ent_i/max(ent) + 0.2/log2(C), automatically biasing toward uncertainty when there are many classes and toward diversity when few.

name: Entropy-weighted BADGE w/ pre-filter
tagline: BADGE k-means++ run on a top-K entropy x grad-norm candidate pool, with each sample's gradient embedding scaled by normalized entropy.
diff_from_baseline: Adds a two-signal pre-filter (entropy x BADGE grad-norm top-K) and re-weights BADGE's residual by normalized entropy before running the standard k-means++ selection in the factored gradient-embedding space.

name: Spherical core-set + least-confidence
tagline: L2-normalize penultimate embeddings, initialize min-distances from the labeled set, then greedy farthest-first weighted by least-confidence uncertainty.
init_recovers: core-set / k-center when U is constant; least-confidence when min_D2 is constant
diff_from_baseline: Replaces BADGE's gradient embedding with L2-normalized penultimate features, seeds the farthest-first loop from the already-labeled set, and weighs each candidate by least-confidence uncertainty (U · sqrt(min_D2)) instead of pure k-center.

name: Density+BALD greedy farthest-first
tagline: Filter on entropy x (1-margin), reweight by light MC-BALD, then greedy farthest-first in concat(emb, 0.5*grad) with density and pseudo-class balancing.
diff_from_baseline: Goes well beyond BADGE/BAIT/BALD: combines entropy x margin pre-filter, MC-BALD epistemic correction, density regularization in a joint emb+grad space, pseudo-class frequency balancing, and a labeled-set-aware greedy farthest-first update.

name: Harmonic dual-signal + farthest-first
tagline: Rank-normalize entropy and BADGE grad-norm, take their harmonic mean, top-K filter, then greedy farthest-first on L2-normalized raw features weighted by score.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces BADGE's gradient k-means++ with a two-signal harmonic mean of rank-normalized entropy and grad-norm, a 15n top-K candidate filter, and farthest-first selection on L2-normalized raw features (or grad as fallback) weighted by the normalized score.
